title: Source-bound fixed irrigation application-type materialization

equations: For irrigation type<2, assign rate to the surface gross rate and concentration to surface irrigation concentration.
For type=2, assign the rate uniformly to the configured SSDI node range and sum those node rates.
Event duration is depth/rate and the selected event index advances on match.

scope: existing typed fixed-event evaluator for sprinkler, surface and SSDI source assignments
100000 deterministic complete-interval source comparisons across all three application types
surface concentration/rate, SSDI selected-node layout, event duration and candidate event-index advance
non_goals: date/calendar matching beyond the separately tested fixed-date selector
legacy long-duration correction; B1 input parsing rejects fixed events longer than one day
solute transport, owner-bound accepted mass, transaction, restart or production admission
pass_conditions: application type<2 materializes surface rate and concentration only
application type=2 materializes equal rates only across the selected SSDI range
complete event amount and duration match the typed source result
100000 deterministic source comparisons pass at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
